craft_claim: Grounding the sacred in a concrete body, labour, or named place produces piercing devotion; the ethereal 'hushed' register is a Western default, not a universal of reverent writing.

supporting_evidence.location: Vachanas of Basava and Allama Prabhu
supporting_evidence.note: The Viraśaiva vachanas locate the divine in the living body (legs as pillars, head as cupola) and in daily trade; Allama Prabhu's bedagu images defy paraphrase to force non-literal apprehension.

supporting_evidence.location: Selection across Basava, Akka Mahadevi, Allama Prabhu
supporting_evidence.note: Devotion is confrontational and embodied - the speaker scolds, bargains with, and loves a specific deity, refusing passive adoration.

scope: Concrete-image operator; Indian/regional anchor; cross-links axis-vachana-poetry and genres/vachana-poetry.md.
exceptions: Apophatic and contemplative traditions may deliberately abstract the sacred; the two moves are complementary, not mutually exclusive.
